newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo naphtha quiet due to uncertainty over Iraq.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo naphtha quiet due to uncertainty over Iraq.

text.p: Tokyo naphtha prices drifted sideways in afternoon trading on Wednesday in a quiet market where dealers stuck to the sidelines due to uncertainty over developments in the Middle East, traders said.
"Both sellers and buyers are still nervous about the Iraqi situation," one naphtha trader said. "They are waiting to see what will happen next."
Open-spec naphtha for first-half November was notionally assessed bid at $201.50 and offered at $203.00 in late afternoon trading.
